description: Permanent abstention boundary — R5 is policy, not another auto-resolve research track. CG-6.3 semantic inheritance is operationalized; do not invent rules to chase 67→66 mapping deltas.

flow: enabled semantic rule with full deterministic evidence?
forbidden: semantic rule that creates ontology or platform concepts
new rules without benchmark regression + abstention matrix + incremental accounting vs prior validated baseline

abstentionDefinition.meaning: Matcher recognized partial semantic evidence in rule scope but deliberately refused auto-resolve because evidence did not satisfy the frozen rule.
abstentionDefinition.successCriterion: Abstention is as valuable as auto-resolve when it prevents false inheritance

whenToAbstain: Partial token overlap without full rule compound (e.g. leakage without drain, PBA without communication, overflow without OC)
Excluded hostile tokens present (mems, motor, water, inlet, door, drain on overflow rule, etc.)
Insufficient prior platform/corpus concept — requiredPlatformConcept not established
semanticRiskClass high rules: any ambiguity → abstain, not extrapolate
Ambiguous semantic candidate with no human-proven closed loop
New platform concept disguised as inheritance (e.g. mems_sensor must not be absorbed by PBA communication rule)
whenNotToAddRules: Chasing marginal mapping burden reduction (67→66) without new evidence class
Terminology normalization that does not increase semantic distance proof
Rules outside frozen calibration corpus without new human gate provenance
Before appliance graph expansion delivers more manuals to compound against

requires: Human-proven closed loop with frozen provenance artifact
Incremental accounting vs last validated rule baseline
Explicit semanticRiskClass when crossing into functional inference
mayNotCreateConcept: true when inheriting existing platform/corpus concepts only

nextWork: Canonical graph #2 — dryer ontology + manual→overlay compounding (see CG-6.4-dryer-canonical-graph.md)
